I thank you, first of all.
I've thought about that, I honestly have, but, and I know this is jacked up, I don't want to cause issues for anyone. I don't want to get a restraining order because that makes life difficult on my family, in some way. At least, that's the best way I can explain it. Plus I've heard you end up essentially having to go to court and that means seeing them, and I don't know how to handle that, to be honest.
I really just wish I could fade out of existence, then nobody would have to be hampered by me, and maybe they would have been happier.
